Summarize asks a local OpenAI-compatible model server ([llm.summaries]
endpoint in the index configuration; agent never starts one) for a summary,
a why and three to five plain asks for each file of the full-depth projects
that gets one, checks each answer in code, and keeps it in Postgres keyed
by the file's content key and the run's fingerprint (the model and its
snapshot, the server, the prompt, sampling, clipping, filters, checks and
this build). A sync then shows a summary over the file's seed while the
file is unchanged and queues the changed cards for agent index embed.

Skipped, before any read: sensitive names, files with no content, fixture,
data and asset kinds, vendored code, program output directories (outputs,
results, snapshots, runs, logs), directories of 50+ numbered files, lock and
checksum files, licenses and ignore files, JSON that isn't a manifest or a
small hand-written file; after reading: trivial files and generated ones.
--coverage prints what would be summarized and what is skipped and why, by
project and kind, and the 20 directories with the most skipped, without
calling the model.

A run resumes: files already summarized (or failed) under the same
fingerprint are skipped; files the server didn't answer in time (5xx,
timeouts, past --file-timeout) get no row, so a resume asks again. It
stops cleanly and exits 1 when the server stops answering (8 connection
errors in a row, or /health failing), when no file finished for --stall,
after --max-time, or when over --max-error-rate of the last --error-window
files failed; its stats (done, remaining, skipped, errors, rate, ETA) are
saved in its runs row and --stats FILE as it goes. --skip-project leaves a
project out; --own-files PROJECT=FILE keeps only a fork's own files.

Usage:
  agent index summarize [flags]

Examples:
  agent index summarize --coverage --project gomuxai
  agent index summarize --project gomuxai --limit 100 --stats run.json
  agent index summarize --prefix 'lab:research/' --limit 50
  agent index summarize --skip-project vendor-fork --max-time 4h --stats status.json

Flags:
      --config string              The index configuration (TOML; default: AGENT_INDEX_CONFIG, else ~/.config/gomuxai/index.toml, else built-in defaults)
      --corpus stringArray         Files of this corpus (code, prose; repeatable); default code
      --coverage                   Print what would be summarized and what is skipped, and why; call no model
      --dirs                       The bottom-up pass: summarize the directories holding the selected files, deepest first, then their projects, from their README, listing and children's summaries (run it after the files); --limit N samples N of them
      --error-window int           Stop the run when over --max-error-rate of this many latest files failed (0: never) (default 200)
      --file-timeout duration      One file's deadline, all its requests and retries together; past it the file gets no row, so a resume asks again (default 10m)
  -h, --help                       help for summarize
      --json                       Print the coverage report or the run's stats as JSON
      --limit int                  At most this many files per project (or prefix), sampled evenly; 0 is all
      --max-error-rate string      The failed share of --error-window files that stops the run (default "0.2")
      --max-time duration          Stop the run cleanly after this long (0: no cap; with --dirs, counted from the pass's start)
      --no-sync                    Don't sync afterwards (the summaries show after the next sync)
      --out string                 Write the coverage report (or the run's stats) as JSON here
      --own-files stringArray      PROJECT=FILE: summarize only the files FILE lists (paths in the project, one a line) of that fork; its others count as upstream (repeatable)
      --prefix stringArray         Only files whose id starts so, as project:dir/ (repeatable)
      --project stringArray        Only this project (repeatable); default every full-depth project
      --retry-failed               Ask again for files that failed under this fingerprint
      --skip-prefix stringArray    Leave files whose id starts so out, as project:dir/ (repeatable); they count as skipped
      --skip-project stringArray   Leave this project out (repeatable); its files count as skipped
      --stall duration             Stop the run when no file finished for this long (0: never; with --dirs, over the whole pass) (default 10m)
      --stats string               Rewrite the run's stats here as it goes (with --dirs: the whole pass's status)

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
